independent_case.title: Apply a new case independently
independent_case.task: Four runs on each of two cases: first passes 4, second passes 2. Compute overall run rate and per-case rates.
independent_case.answer: Teacher explanation: 6/8=75% run rate; case rates 100% and 50%. There are two distinct cases, not eight independent task contexts.
independent_case.source: primary source W4, first curriculum occurrence

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
A deterministic mocked output tests the pipeline contract but cannot estimate an unspecified live model distribution.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.

blocks.text: Use fixed evidence and rubric per case. Require supported room/capacity, valid schema and no actions. Repeats estimate observed variation for this case; they are not additional independent users.
